title: Subscription
description: A recurring subscription that needs to be cancelled, transferred, or maintained after death — streaming, utilities, memberships, software

billingFrequency.description: How often the subscription is billed

accountIdentifier.description: Account number, email, or username for this subscription

cancelAction.description: What should happen to this subscription after death

transferToPersonId.description: Person.id to transfer the subscription to

transferToPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced transfer to person

cancellationInfo.description: Information about how to cancel this subscription, particularly after a death. Complements the reference-data/subscription-cancellation-guide.json with per-subscription instance data

retrievedAt.description: When this cancellation information was researched or verified

difficulty.description: How much friction the provider creates when cancelling
difficulty.$comment: easy: can be done online in a few clicks. medium: requires a phone call or email exchange. hard: requires phone call, multiple steps, retention attempts, or physical post

cancellationUrl.description: Direct URL to the cancellation page or form

cancellationPhone.description: Phone number required for cancellation, if phone-only

deathCertificateRequired.description: Whether the provider requires a death certificate to cancel on behalf of a deceased person

refundAvailable.description: Whether a pro-rata refund is available when cancelling due to death

provenance.description: Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it
